title: The Deep Protocol
author: Paloma Underhill
blurb: Ulyana Eriksen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
